problem_title: Recurring Tarring Or Asphalting Of Existing Road — Benniganahalli (2019–2020)
problem_summary: 5 citizen complaints about 'Tarring Or Asphalting Of Existing Road' were recorded in Benniganahalli between August 2019 and May 2020, spanning 2 calendar year(s). 20% of these complaints remain unresolved (status: Open or Re-opened).
representative_subcategory: Tarring Or Asphalting Of Existing Road

evidence_items.source: I Change My City (ichangemycity.com) via OpenCity

evidence_items.description: KAUN 2022 data: ward recorded 63 pothole complaints.
34 road/drain work order(s) sanctioned in ward (₹13.0 crore, FY 2023-24, 2024-25). Note: work order ward mapping uses datameet243 numbering (exact_name join).

agency_attribution_note: 5 of 5 complaints explicitly name BBMP as the responsible agency in the source data.
priority_rationale: Priority tier LOW (score=0.27). Top scoring factors: recurrence_years=0.67, unresolved_rate=0.20, description_severity=0.18.
ward_join_note: ICMC ward_name='Benniganahalli' matched to datameet243=118 via exact_name (overlap_confidence=0.85).
recommended_next_steps: File an RTI (Right to Information) request to BBMP requesting the road repair history for Benniganahalli for the period 2019–2020.
Request inspection records for the 34 work order(s) sanctioned in this ward to verify whether road works covered the affected stretch.
Re-survey affected stretch using a civic volunteer or journalist to document current road condition.
